# Astris Space

> Astris Space (ASTRIS SPACEED LLP) is an Indian astronomy and space-education company based in Delhi NCR and an ISRO-registered Space Tutor. It runs the Astris Astronomy Club for schools, AstroEd Space Labs, astronomy experiences for resorts (AstroTrain), dark-sky trips (Astroventure) and builds its own telescopes under the Nakshatra Scopes brand.

## For schools
- [Astris Astronomy Club](https://www.astriseducation.in/astronomy-club): a weekly, NCERT-linked astronomy club for Grades 4–12, run on the school's campus at no cost to the school. 32 sessions a year, three grade bands, real telescopes, safe solar observing, take-home builds and family sky-watches. Schools book a free 20-minute assembly demo or request a quote.
- [Astronomy club for schools: guide and city pages](https://www.astriseducation.in/astronomy-club-for-schools): how a school astronomy club works, how to start one, activities by grade, and city guides for Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Pune, Chennai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, Lucknow and Chandigarh.
- [AstroEd Space Lab](https://www.astriseducation.in/astroed): a permanent astronomy lab and curriculum for schools.
- [Astronomy education guides](https://www.astriseducation.in/astronomy-education)
